source.aggregateQuery:
with scope as materialized (
 select spr.*,cp.id product_id,coalesce(nullif(spr.product_code,''),cp.product_code,spr.normalized_code) code,
 coalesce(nullif(cp.description,''),spr.description,'') product_description,coalesce(nullif(cp.oem_no,''),spr.oem_no,'') oem,
 cp.hs_code,cp.origin,cp.weight_kg,s.name cheapest_name,coalesce(nullif(spr.second_supplier_name,''),s2.name) second_name
 from public.supplier_price_rollups spr
 left join lateral (select c.* from public.catalog_products c where c.organization_id=spr.organization_id and c.brand_id=spr.brand_id and c.normalized_code=spr.normalized_code order by c.product_code,c.id limit 1) cp on true
 left join public.suppliers s on s.id=spr.cheapest_supplier_id and s.organization_id=spr.organization_id
 left join public.suppliers s2 on s2.id=spr.second_supplier_id and s2.organization_id=spr.organization_id
 where spr.organization_id='1e4c5e99-e387-41aa-a6d3-cbe74558f766' and spr.brand_id='821a7c95-dd21-4ae8-b55b-fe463fa0b7ca' and spr.cheapest_price is not null
), fields as (
 select *,array[btrim(code),'Corteco',product_description,oem,coalesce(hs_code,''),coalesce(origin,''),coalesce(trim_scale(weight_kg)::text,''),coalesce(cheapest_name,''),trim_scale(cheapest_price)::text,coalesce(second_name,''),coalesce(trim_scale(second_price)::text,''),coalesce(trim_scale(second_price-cheapest_price)::text,''),coalesce(trim_scale(round((second_price-cheapest_price)*100/nullif(cheapest_price,0),2))::text,''),coalesce(price_date::text,''),trim_scale(round(cheapest_price*1.10,2))::text,trim_scale(round(cheapest_price*1.15,2))::text,supplier_count::text,case when product_id is null then 'Supplier Only' else 'In Catalog' end,coalesce(notes,'')] vals from scope
), checked as (
 select *,md5((select string_agg(octet_length(v)::text||':'||v,'' order by ord) from unnest(vals) with ordinality f(v,ord))) row_hash,
 (select count(distinct sp.supplier_id) from public.supplier_prices sp where sp.organization_id=f.organization_id and sp.brand_id=f.brand_id and sp.normalized_code=f.normalized_code and sp.is_active and sp.currency='EUR' and sp.valid_from<=current_date and (sp.valid_to is null or sp.valid_to>=current_date) and ((sp.supplier_id=f.cheapest_supplier_id and sp.buy_price=f.cheapest_price) or (sp.supplier_id=f.second_supplier_id and sp.buy_price=f.second_price))) matched_suppliers
 from fields f)
 select clock_timestamp() observed_at,count(*) source_rows,md5(string_agg(row_hash,'' order by row_hash collate "C")) semantic_multiset_md5,md5(string_agg(md5(btrim(code)),'' order by md5(btrim(code)) collate "C")) product_code_multiset_md5,count(*) filter(where matched_suppliers<>2) source_supplier_price_mismatches,count(*) filter(where supplier_count<>2) supplier_count_mismatches,public.get_catalog_master_export_version('1e4c5e99-e387-41aa-a6d3-cbe74558f766','821a7c95-dd21-4ae8-b55b-fe463fa0b7ca','priced') current_data_version from checked;

equality.method: Complete UTF-8 length-framed field multiset digest comparison, with exact numeric decimal normalization. Independently compare every exported A/B value against cheapest price at10%/15%, and every selected source supplier price against an active eligible supplier-price row.

limitations: This verifies the complete production Corteco comparison export; it does not prove corrected mixed published/legacy Master-source behavior.
The UI total50 display issue is distinct from this complete30328-row file and has separate source review.
